body:
REV 14 (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-26 about 10:10Z), reconciling with the interim slot rule after Merger2's report (891850c6 #265).

CURRENT STATE:
- Rule (1) below (unrestricted self-serve builds, no slot, no count cap) is SUSPENDED since 2026-10-26 about 07:15Z.
- It is replaced by memory termal-build-slot-rule-2026-10-26 (the interim BUILD-SLOT RULE), agreed by Fable2 and Engram::Fable after the 06:12:10Z whole-machine commit exhaustion. That event crashed termal.exe and several rustc processes (item w-002b151e7b26).
- The suspension lasts until w-002b's launcher-enforced resource admission lands. Then this memory is revised again.
- What the slot rule means in practice: lanes do NOT self-serve. They mail "BUILD SLOT request", wait for "GRANTED" from Fable2, and mail "BUILD SLOT END"; the limits are 1 cargo build or test per project, at least 20 GB free commit, and -j 4 or less.
- The slot rule's "full gate holds both slots for its first 20 minutes" is a memory-safety deviation from Greg's rev-12 word against synchronizing builds with gates. The basis is the measured OOM crash, not I/O. It is disclosed to Greg through Advisor.

Rules (2) one full gate host-wide, (3) no two sessions in the same source root, and (4) I/O monitoring are UNCHANGED.

Greg's rev-12 word, verbatim (Advisor #1683): "remove the cross-project rule 'no builds during a gate rust stage'. Do not synchronize ordinary builds/warm runs/focused checks against a gate; run ready independent work normally in parallel. Keep only one full gate host-wide for exact-result/ownership integrity, and avoid only actual same-source-root conflicts. Continue monitoring I/O and report concrete regressions."

Rev-12 rules, kept for reference:
(1) [SUSPENDED, see above] Builds, checks and focused runs: unrestricted, self-serve in the lane's own root, with START and END mailed.
(2) ONE full gate host-wide. The ready→"clear" handshake covers gate ownership only.
(3) No two sessions in the same source root.
(4) Monitor I/O (GET /api/diagnostics/persistence) and report concrete regressions.

Revs 1–11 are superseded. Never inflate timeouts.
